description:
Small core PR, after the site-inputs bundle changes are on develop and before the site repo is seeded.

Today a failed `site-inputs.yml` run on develop raises no alert. Neither the develop workflow nor the corrected one has an issue step. The plan opens a `site-bundle-failed` issue only from the site deploy plane, for a dispatch that arrived. A core build failure never dispatches, so the only signal is a red workflow run.

1. Add a final step to `.github/workflows/site-inputs.yml` with `if: failure()`.
2. Using `github.token` with `issues: write`, open one issue labelled `site-bundle-failed`, or comment on the open one. Include the core SHA, the run URL and the failed attestation names.
3. Close nothing automatically; the next green run may comment that the chain recovered.
4. The workflow is a soundness path, so the PR needs oracle review. It needs no GitHub App.
